summary: Marksmanship with Lone Wolf (+20% damage with no pet out). It beats a cat because a Forever pet takes no player buffs.
rotation: Pre-pull: Aspect of the Hawk at -3s, Rapid Fire at -0.1s
Rapid Fire, racials, potions and Demonic Rune on cooldown
Arcane Shot on cooldown (above Aimed Shot, no mana floor)
Aimed Shot on the cooldown it shares with Multi-Shot
Scorpid Sting (2% off the boss's hit, 9% of base mana) at the pull and again in its last 2s, in place of Serpent Sting; the raid's Scorpid Sting is off
Sniper Shot on cooldown while mana >= 15 x seconds left
caveats: Assumed: Trueshot Aura's top rank gives 100 ranged attack power and Hunter's Mark's 140 (the client has 50 and 71).
Aspect of the Hawk stays at rank 5 (90 RAP). Forever's rank 6 gives only 55.
Arcane Shot takes 10% of ranged attack power and Serpent Sting 3% a tick (beta log fit: 11% and 3.5%).
Assumed: Auto Shot fires through casts with no 0.5s aim.
Wildstalker Armor 4-piece and 5-piece aren't active. They would add 17.
Rapid Killing never triggers on a single boss.
Assumed: 22% more crit per Agility than Classic.
A 2.5s bow at Rhok'delar's 44.0 DPS. A 2.6s gun sims 0.3 to 1.0 higher with a 15% ammo pouch, 3.4 to 5.2 lower with Era's 14% pouch.
Costs 96.9 / 95.5 / 77.1 DPS vs Lone Wolf at 120s / 180s / 300s, mostly Serpent Sting's damage.
The sting only lowers the boss's hit by 2%. It adds no raid damage.
notes: Request is hunter__lone-wolf's with the rotation swapped for ui/hunter/apls/lw_scorpid.apl.json (tools/rotopt/hunter_presets.sh) and debuffs.scorpidSting removed; mksettings writes the same raid as spec hunter_lw_scorpid. Request written by mksettings (spec hunter_lw) unchanged; it matches the shipped preset's gear, talents, APL, race, consumes, raid buffs, debuffs and professions. Pet set to none (petType omitted = PetNone).
